title: RESIDE SOTS Indoor Asset Qualification v1
rationale: Qualify the requested local RESIDE SOTS Indoor asset with one fixed CPU-only pass over 50 clear and 500 hazy PNG files. Bind exact paths and aggregate SHA-256 identities, require ten hazy variants per clear scene, fully decode every file, and require paired dimensions to match. Do not load a model or checkpoint, run inference or training, compute restoration metrics, display images, or produce a model-quality conclusion.

scientific_contract.question: Does the registered local RESIDE SOTS tree contain one decodable, dimension-matched SOTS Indoor paired asset with exactly 50 clear scenes and 500 hazy variants?

research_update_binding.bottleneck_statement: SOTS Indoor has historical preparation count checks but no current GitHub-main terminal binding its exact local files, pairing, decodability, dimensions, and aggregate identity.

literature_basis.transferable_claim: SOTS provides paired synthetic indoor benchmark images for single-image dehazing evaluation.
literature_basis.applicability_limit: The publication does not prove the identity, completeness, decodability, pairing, or dimensions of this local filesystem copy.

hypotheses.statement: The registered SOTS root resolves to the requested Indoor tree with exactly 50 clear and 500 hazy PNG files.
hypotheses.discriminating_prediction: A fixed nonrecursive census produces the exact frozen counts and three reproducible aggregate SHA-256 identities.
hypotheses.falsifier: The path, directory type, file type, count, or aggregate identity construction is incomplete or ambiguous.

hypotheses.statement: Every clear scene has exactly ten named hazy variants, all 550 files fully decode, and every hazy-clear pair has identical pixel dimensions.
hypotheses.discriminating_prediction: The source-stem mapping covers all 50 clear scenes, has a uniform variant count of ten, and yields 550 decodes plus 500 matched dimensions.
hypotheses.falsifier: Any file is unmapped, duplicated, undecodable, missing, or dimensionally inconsistent with its paired clear image.

design_selection.decision_value: One fixed asset pass establishes all location, count, pairing, decode, dimension, and aggregate-hash facts needed for registration.
design_selection.expected_time_to_decision: One CPU-only sequential read and decode of 550 PNG files.
design_selection.shared_setup: All checks reuse the same registered SOTS root and in-memory file census without model or checkpoint setup.
design_selection.worst_case_stopping_cost: Read and decode at most 550 PNG files, write one compact summary and one completed-unit record, then stop.

arms.description: The frozen requested path, counts, pairing rule, decode rule, and dimension rule.
The registered local SOTS Indoor directory observed by one fixed CPU-only qualification pass.

estimable_terms: observed local asset equality to the frozen qualification contract
decision_design.alias_structure: Not applicable; one explicit identity-source factor is checked without interactions.

mechanism_estimands.prediction: The observed path and fixed census equal the reference contract and produce complete aggregate identities.
mechanism_estimands.falsifier: Any path, file-type, count, or aggregate-identity construction check fails.

mechanism_estimands.prediction: All clear scenes have ten mapped variants, all images decode, and all pair dimensions match.
mechanism_estimands.falsifier: Any mapping, variant-count, decode, or paired-dimension check fails.

decision_design.multiplicity_control: Closed deterministic family: both predeclared mechanism estimands must pass, so no selective success claim is possible.

boundaries.success: All predeclared deterministic asset gates pass.
boundaries.futility: Not applicable; this is one fixed terminal-only qualification.
boundaries.precision: Not applicable; no sampled performance estimand is used.
boundaries.validity: Any identity, pairing, decode, or dimension failure yields an inconclusive qualification.

intervention.primary_variable: local SOTS Indoor asset identity and pairing integrity
intervention.reference: registered RESIDE SOTS root at the frozen GitHub-main snapshot
intervention.matched_budget: one fixed census, SHA-256 pass, and decode pass over 50 clear plus 500 hazy PNG files
fixed_factors: clear files are direct PNG children of gt
hazy files are direct PNG children of hazy
hazy source identity is the filename stem before the first underscore
each clear scene requires exactly ten hazy variants
aggregate SHA-256 uses sorted relative path, byte size, and file SHA-256 records
no model, checkpoint, inference, training, restoration metric, or image display

primary_estimand.aggregation: clear scenes satisfying the exact ten-variant pairing, decode, and dimension contract, subject to dataset-wide identity and isolation gates, divided by 50

controls: source-stem pairing with ten variants per clear scene
full Pillow decode without image display
zero model, checkpoint, inference, training, and restoration metric calls

gates.reference: exact requested root, direct regular PNG files, and complete aggregate SHA-256 construction
exactly 50 unique clear stems, 500 mapped hazy files, ten variants per clear, no unmapped or unused scene
all 550 files fully decode and all 500 mapped hazy-clear pairs have identical dimensions
zero model, checkpoint, inference, training, restoration metric, image display, and protected-data operations

scientific_contract.competing_explanation: Historical extraction counts alone can appear complete while the current path contains corrupted images, incorrect pair names, dimension mismatches, or changed file bytes.
disabled_actions: PSNR, SSIM, perceptual, or restoration metric computation
image display or human visual inspection

precision_contract.rationale: The qualification is an exact finite asset census and integrity check, not a sampled performance estimate.
